question: Can an independent reorder-pair corpus, private three-way oracle, analyzer prediction, and reveal score be kept role-separated and cryptographically bound while reusing final-blind v2 canonical hashing and artifact-freeze conventions?

roles.selector: Chooses 20-40 exact pairs from at least three frameworks and two domains without analyzer predictions, receipts, private labels, or P5K-P5M pair labels.
roles.annotators: A primary and reviewer label exact source/config/domain/RNG-bound statements without analyzer outputs; an adjudicator resolves disagreements.
roles.oracle_custodian: Holds the salted private oracle and releases only its commitment before prediction seal.
roles.analyzer_operator: Sees only the sealed public manifest, public source, analyzer bundle, and oracle commitment until prediction seal.
roles.evaluator: Verifies both commitments after reveal and computes frozen metrics without changing predictions or labels.

hypotheses.h1_schema: Public, private, and prediction fixtures validate against separate exact schemas.
hypotheses.h2_leakage: Answer-bearing public/prediction keys, independence violations, contamination, ID mismatch, missing units, and label/witness inconsistencies fail closed.
hypotheses.h3_commitments: Post-commit oracle tampering and post-seal prediction tampering are detected; the public freeze contains no private oracle path or content.
hypotheses.h4_scoring: Reveal reports unsafe Supported first, preserves Unknown as a separate denominator, checks all frozen gates, and detects a synthetic unsafe Supported prediction.
hypotheses.h5_self_test: A 24-pair, three-framework, two-domain synthetic administrative fixture passes exactly 30 checks.

pass_rule: All 30 synthetic administrative checks pass and all frozen predecessor hashes remain exact.
no_go_rule: This package cannot be called independent evidence until real selectors and annotators satisfy the roles, a real private oracle is committed, predictions are sealed before reveal, and no analyzer developer has seen private labels.
claim_boundary: Administrative handoff readiness only; synthetic framework names, labels, predictions, scores, and burden values are not scientific evidence.
